import json, os, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import observe_output as O
fixture = open("tests/fixtures/observe/codex.jsonl", "rb").read()
fixture_tid = [json.loads(line)["thread_id"] for line in fixture.decode().splitlines() if json.loads(line).get("type") == "thread.started"][0]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp, tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as fake_home:
    os.environ["CODEX_SESSIONS_DIR"] = tmp
    tid = "11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555"
    raw = (json.dumps({"type": "thread.started", "thread_id": tid}) + "\n" + json.dumps({"type": "turn.completed", "usage": {"input_tokens": 1, "output_tokens": 1, "cached_input_tokens": 0, "reasoning_output_tokens": 0}}) + "\n").encode()
    rec = os.path.join(tmp, f"rollout-{tid}.jsonl")
    for bad in (
        {"model": "gpt-5.6-luna\n/Users/secret\u0000sk-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz", "cwd": "/Users/secret", "instructions": "do not leak"},
        {"model": "a" * 200},
        {"model": "gpt-5.6-luna\n"},
    ):
        with open(rec, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(bad) + "\n")
        obs = O.observe("codex", raw)
        assert obs["observed_model"] == {"value": None, "source": "unknown"}, obs
        dumped = json.dumps(obs)
        assert "/Users/secret" not in dumped and "sk-" not in dumped and "do not leak" not in dumped
    with open(rec, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps({"model": "gpt-5.6-luna"}) + "\n")
    assert O.observe("codex", raw)["observed_model"] == {"value": "gpt-5.6-luna", "source": "observed"}
    home_sessions = os.path.join(fake_home, ".codex", "sessions")
    os.makedirs(home_sessions)
    with open(os.path.join(home_sessions, f"rollout-{fixture_tid}.jsonl"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps({"model": "SHOULD-NOT-BE-READ"}) + "\n")
    os.environ["HOME"] = fake_home
    assert O.observe("codex", fixture)["observed_model"] == {"value": None, "source": "unknown"}
    os.environ.pop("CODEX_SESSIONS_DIR", None)
    assert O.observe("codex", fixture)["observed_model"] == {"value": "SHOULD-NOT-BE-READ", "source": "observed"}
print("ok")
